# Contributing to NyayaLens

Thank you for your interest in contributing to NyayaLens!

## Code Quality Standards
* Python backend code must strictly pass `ruff check app tests` and `mypy app`.
* Unit test coverage on core business logic must remain >= 85% (`pytest --cov=app`).
* TypeScript frontend code must be strictly typed without `any` and pass `npm run build`.
* All user-facing text and controls must adhere to WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines.
* Every answer and extraction generated by AI features must be grounded in verified document citations.
